parsed.g: Preview the Magento Luma theme for the shop via the Magento Admin panel
P_t: Identified the CONTENT menu item in the top navigation bar
Opened the CONTENT menu to reveal submenu items including Design > Themes
R_t: Successfully navigate to Content > Design > Themes page
Locate the Magento Luma theme in the themes list
Click the preview option for the Luma theme
parsed.e_t: The ground-truth DOM at step 3 shows a Magento Admin login page (adminhtml-auth-login), not the Themes page or Dashboard. The page contains a login form with username and password fields and a 'Sign in' button. This indicates the agent's session has expired or the navigation to the Themes page caused a redirect to the login page. The agent's observed DOM (still showing the Dashboard) is stale and does not reflect the actual environment state.
C: The agent must re-authenticate (log in) before it can access any admin pages, as the ground-truth DOM shows the session has been lost and the login page is now displayed
Navigation to Content > Design > Themes must be completed after re-authentication

F_t.cause: Clicking the Themes link caused a session expiry or redirect; the ground-truth DOM at step 3 shows the admin login page instead of the Themes page, indicating the session was lost during navigation
The agent attempted to scroll down on what it believed was the Themes page, but the ground-truth DOM shows the login page is displayed, so scrolling had no effect toward the goal

K_t: The Themes link is located under Content > Design > Themes in the admin navigation (node [474])
